explanation: `app.css` declared `scrollbar-color` on every element, and the reduced-motion blanket sets `transition-duration: 0.01ms !important` on everything. `scrollbar-color` is animatable, so under the blanket Chromium starts a `scrollbar-color` transition on every restyled element, cascading one level per frame; readiness took 2-4x longer under reduced motion and ran into the 30 s test timeout.
fix: Declare `scrollbar-color` once on `:root`/theme roots (it is inherited) instead of on every element; a component test guards against per-element declarations.
